name: Mason Holland
headline: Senior Web Developer
summary: Senior Web Developer with 7+ years of experience in web application development and product-focused engineering. Expertise in front-end development for a high-traffic member site serving over 20 million users, and full-stack delivery of internal tools that enhanced developer workflows. Demonstrated technical leadership across cross-functional teams, with automated testing suites built and maintained across web, iOS and Android.

experience.summary: Front-end and full-stack engineering for the Aetna member website and internal developer tools.
highlights: Engineered and maintained features for the Aetna member website, serving over 20 million users, with a focus on scalability, reliability and rigorous accessibility standards.
Moved to a full-stack team to build internal tools that streamlined test user creation and lookup, solving significant problems for developers and product teams.
Helped integrate and scale the use of AI tools across the organization, improving development processes.

experience.summary: Test automation and quality engineering across web and mobile.
highlights: Engineered and maintained automated testing suites for web, iOS and Android, with unit, integration and end-to-end coverage.
Led end-to-end test automation, making sound technical decisions in complex scenarios.
Explained testing processes and reliability outcomes to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

accolades.title: Back End Engineering
accolades.from: Turing School of Software and Design
accolades.summary: Full-time program (Mar to Nov 2017) in object-oriented Ruby and Ruby on Rails RESTful APIs, finishing with full-stack group projects in JavaScript and Node.
